name: grapesjs-forms
description: GrapesJS plugin: a form editor of its own (field types, options, placeholders, attributes, hidden fields with values). A form becomes a component styled by the site's own CSS; submissions go to a REST API (openapi.yaml), IndexedDB or memory. SurveyJS JSON import/export.

scripts.build: vite build && vite build -c vite.runtime.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('dist/grapesjs-forms.umd.cjs','dist/grapesjs-forms.umd.js')"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build

author: Alexander Shibisty
